list_certificates.title: List certificates and orders
list_certificates.description: List SSL certificates and certificate orders: purchased, uploaded, or test (free) certificates, with their domains, status and expiry. Start here to find a cert_id or order_id.

status.description: Filter by status, e.g. ISSUED, CHECKING, WILLEXPIRED, EXPIRED, REVOKED.

current_page.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The certificates or orders and the total count.

get_certificate.title: Get a certificate
get_certificate.description: Read a certificate's details: domains, issuer, validity, fingerprint, and the certificate and key PEMs. Treat the key as a secret.

cert_filter.description: Return metadata only, without the PEM certificate and key.

upload_certificate.title: Upload a certificate
upload_certificate.description: Upload a certificate issued elsewhere, with its private key, so other Alibaba Cloud services (CDN, SLB, WAF) can use it.

delete_certificate.title: Delete a certificate
delete_certificate.description: Delete an uploaded or expired certificate. Services still using it lose HTTPS until they get another.

get_order_state.title: Get an order's validation state
get_order_state.description: Read where a certificate order is in issuance and, while domain validation is pending, the DNS record or file to create.

output.description: Type (domain_verify, process, certificate, verify_fail), and the validation record or file.

get_package_state.title: Get a certificate package's usage
get_package_state.description: Read how many certificates a resource plan (package) holds, has issued and has left.

product_code.description: The package's product code, e.g. digicert-free-1-free.

request_certificate.title: Request a certificate from a package
request_certificate.description: Apply for a certificate using a purchased or free resource plan. Domain validation is then done by DNS or file; check progress with get_order_state.

domain.description: The domain or domains, comma-separated, e.g. www.example.com.

csr.description: A PEM CSR to use; omit to let the service generate the key pair.

generate_csr_method.description: How the CSR is produced when csr is omitted.

renew_certificate.title: Renew a certificate
renew_certificate.description: Renew a certificate from its resource plan, optionally with a new CSR.

cancel_order.title: Revoke or cancel a certificate order
cancel_order.description: Revoke an issued certificate or cancel a pending order. Revocation cannot be undone.

cancel_pending_request.title: Withdraw a pending request
cancel_pending_request.description: Withdraw a certificate request that is still being validated; the plan quota is returned.

delete_order.title: Delete a failed or cancelled order
delete_order.description: Delete the record of a certificate request that failed validation or was cancelled.

list_csrs.title: List CSRs
list_csrs.description: List certificate signing requests created in the service, with their common name and key algorithm.

current_page.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_csr.title: Create a CSR
create_csr.description: Generate a key pair and certificate signing request in the service, to use when requesting a certificate.

key_size.description: Key size: 2048 or 4096 for RSA, 256 for ECC.

get_csr.title: Get a CSR
get_csr.description: Read a CSR and its private key. Treat the key as a secret.

delete_csr.title: Delete a CSR
delete_csr.description: Delete a CSR and its stored private key.

list_contacts.title: List notification contacts
list_contacts.description: List the contacts who receive certificate expiry and issuance notices.

current_page.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_deployment_jobs.title: List deployment jobs
list_deployment_jobs.description: List jobs that deploy certificates to cloud resources such as CDN, SLB and WAF, with their status.

status.description: Filter by status, e.g. pending, scheduling, processing, success, error.

current_page.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

get_deployment_job.title: Get a deployment job
get_deployment_job.description: Read a certificate deployment job's targets, schedule and per-resource results.

list_cloud_resources.title: List deployable resources
list_cloud_resources.description: List the cloud resources (CDN domains, SLB listeners, WAF sites and more) a certificate can be deployed to, with the certificate each uses.

cloud_product.description: The product, e.g. CDN, SLB, WAF, LIVE.

current_page.description: The page to return, starting at 1.
